answer.rationale: p99 write latency is climbing and confined to the primary region; rollback is forbidden because the build contains a compliance-mandated security patch. Regional failover (memory b2) shifts write traffic out of the degraded region while preserving all writes; it does not require reverting the release. Prior evidence (b2) shows failover restored latency within minutes with clean traffic shift and recovered error rates, and b5 shows read-routing relief is complementary but secondary to the regional isolation needed here. Exactly one intervention is permitted, so failover is the single action; any additional capacity moves wait for the next window.
